description: A later step fails after an earlier one succeeded: compensate, keep the refund, alert support, end PARTIALLY_COMPLETED. Needs PLATFORM_FAULTS_ENABLED=true.

cases.description: The replacement product runs out of stock while the case waits for approval (psql: set its stock to 0): the refund succeeds, the replacement reservation fails, the case ends partially completed with a support task.

setup.before_approval_sql: UPDATE product SET available_qty = 0, reserved_qty = 0 WHERE product_id = 'PRD-101'

input.message: My order {order} has been delayed by five days. Cancel the order, refund me, and suggest a cheaper replacement.
